subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Heterogeneous runtime-object helpers reconstructed from validated function IR: championship-points comparison, config path-string registration, AI flag writing and setup-parameter lookup, vehicle setup-value formatting, container teardown, track-spline extrapolation, tolerance and plane-fit math, physics solver dispatch, weighted accumulator splitting, D3D render-state reset, spatial/mesh structure initialization, shadow-volume extrusion, color packing, triangle intersection, and registry key query.

summary: Thirty-two validated functions grouped into eighteen GUESS-level runtime-object classes. The largest group is a family of seventeen adjacent, identical-body config path-registration delegates (normalize trailing backslash, then StringCopyWithBufferRealloc) all called by ConfigIniParser (0x00421CD0); whether they are distinct call sites of one helper or duplicated inline copies is unresolved. The remaining functions split across championship-points comparison, AI flag writing, setup-param lookup, setup-value formatting, container teardown, track-spline extrapolation, numeric tolerance and plane-fit helpers, a physics solver dispatch, a lookup-weighted accumulator splitter, D3D render-state reset, spatial/mesh rotation-structure initialization, shadow-volume extrusion, color packing, triangle intersection, and a registry value query. All owners are UNKNOWN; class identities and field meanings are GUESS proposals only.

Compute an AI-state flag value as the global threshold dword_5EA2CC plus the object dword at byte offset 0x4, write it via AIStateFlagSetter, and return the setter's result.
Linear keyed lookup over five two-dword setup-parameter records starting at byte offset 0x4144; return the paired second dword on match or -1. Called by AICollision.

Dispatch vehicle setup-value formatting by value type id (angle, pressure with unit-system branch, length with wheel-type offset, degrees/seconds, single-float, integer count) into 64-byte-strided rows.
Teardown and free a container reachable through global dword_7C73E0: free two singly-linked lists, zero list-head field groups, conditionally free member pointers, then free the container.

Build track-spline extrapolation data: sample consecutive spline points, store midpoints, extrapolate two extension segments, apply fixed offsets, and hand the buffer to sub_457F90 with element count dword_5C329C + 5.
Epsilon-tolerance double comparison: return true when the absolute difference of two doubles is below 0.000000001. Used by the suspension wheel dynamics solver.
Initialize a 25-dword scoring-state object: field 0x0 = -1 sentinel, field 0x10 = 1072693248, all other fields zeroed; return this. Called once from SuspensionSetupSectionReader.

Fit a least-squares plane to a point cloud (28-byte stride, doubles at +0/+8/+16) by accumulating normal-equation sums and solving a 3x4 augmented system via sub_5677B0; write a normalized fallback plane on failed solve.

Dispatch a solver operation-type id to one of six physics helpers (delta-tracking, quadratic spring at offsets 0x1838/0x189C, constraint forces, quadratic, force-torque, spring-damper); unrecognized ids return immediately.
Split an input scalar into two lookup-weighted accumulator contributions using a 256-entry table indexed by a wrapping byte counter; both weighted paths always execute.
Reset/init a D3D render-state struct: zero the handle, release the object pointer at +0x4 through vtable slot 0 when non-null, zero +0x8/+0xC/+0x10, set the state mask at +0x18 to 0xFF7FFFFF.

Initialize a rotation/quaternion-like structure from a source: copy four dwords, duplicate two source components, zero intermediate fields plus a 0x2C-byte block, set a -1 sentinel, zero trailing dwords.

Compute a shadow-volume extrusion offset for collision geometry: detect silhouette edges relative to the light on the triangle array at *(this+0x1C), deduplicate them, sum an angular contribution per edge, clamp and write to *(this+0x10).

Pack three color-related bytes from an object into one DWORD stored at the output pointer: low byte from +0x19, second byte from BYTE1(this), high 16 bits from the word at +0x1A; return the output pointer.
Triangle-pair intersection test: edge half-planes, separating-axis tests on both triangles, then 2D line-segment intersection between the two triangles' edges; return 1 on the first crossing else 0.
Query a registry value for a key formatted by StringFormatWith0x40Size; on success capture and return the value at TotalBytesAvail[7] after releasing the query handle, else return -1.

classes.name: ChampionshipPointsComparator
classes.responsibility: Compares the receiver's accumulated championship points against another object's accumulated points and reports whether the difference is at least 16; the compared object is resolved through sub_41F340 with a global default-string fallback (byte_5EA438). Points totals are computed via ChampionshipPointsAccumulator (0x0041F220).

classes.name: ConfigPathRegistrationDelegates
classes.responsibility: Family of adjacent, identical-body __stdcall delegates that normalize a trailing backslash on a path string in place via PathTrailingBackslashNormalizer (0x00421890) and return the result of StringCopyWithBufferRealloc (0x00566650); all are reached from ConfigIniParser (0x00421CD0) when registering path-valued config entries. Whether they are distinct call sites of one helper or duplicated inline copies is unresolved.

classes.name: AIStateFlagWrapper
classes.responsibility: Computes an AI-state flag value as the global threshold dword_5EA2CC plus the receiver's dword at byte offset 0x4, writes it through AIStateFlagSetter (0x0042AC70), and returns the setter's result unchanged.

classes.name: SetupParamResolver
classes.responsibility: Linear lookup over five two-dword setup-parameter records starting at byte offset 0x4144 of the receiver: scans the first dword of each record for a key, returns the paired second dword on a match, or -1 after five records. Read-only; called by AICollision (0x004BEF60).

classes.name: SetupValueFormatter
classes.responsibility: Formats a vehicle-setup value by value type id: angle in degrees (case 0), pressure with an imperial/metric branch on the unit-system flag at byte offset 0x4 (case 1), lengths with an optional wheel-type offset (cases 2/3/9), degrees/seconds (case 4), single-float (cases 5-8), and integer count (case 10). Rows are 64-byte slots at ((type + 11*group) << 6) + base + 176; formatting goes through StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck (0x0058815F) or the SetupValueFormat helpers (0x0042F260/0x0042F180/0x0042F1E0). The unit strings at this+8 and this+40 and the row field layout belong to an unidentified setup/menu object.

classes.name: RuntimeObjectContainer
classes.responsibility: Tears down a container object reachable through the global dword_7C73E0: when non-null, walks and frees two singly-linked lists (heads at +48 and +32, next pointer at node+4), zeroes those four-slot field groups, conditionally frees member pointers at +16/+8/+0, then frees the container itself. On a null global the decompiled path returns an uninitialized result value.

classes.name: TrackSplineExtrapolator
classes.responsibility: Builds track-spline extrapolation data: zero-fills a local buffer, samples consecutive track-spline points from the scene via sub_403CD0 (scene base dword_5EA2C0), stores midpoints, extrapolates two Catmull-Rom-style extension segments, negates and applies fixed per-component offsets, then hands the buffer to sub_457F90 with element count dword_5C329C + 5.

classes.name: NumericToleranceComparator
classes.responsibility: __stdcall double tolerance comparison: returns TRUE when the absolute difference of the two double arguments is below the epsilon constant 0.000000001, i.e. the two values are equal within tolerance. The packet deterministically lists dbl_59EAD8 as the read global backing the epsilon literal (identity DERIVED). Used by the suspension wheel dynamics solver (0x0043F7F0).

classes.name: CategoryScoringState
classes.responsibility: Constructor-like initializer for a 25-dword scoring-state object at `this`: field 0x0 is set to -1, field 0x10 to the decimal literal 1072693248, and all other fields 0x0..0x60 to 0. No reads, no globals, no branches; returns this. Called once from SuspensionSetupSectionReader (0x00435410).

classes.name: BestFitPlaneFitter
classes.responsibility: Fits a least-squares plane to a2 points at a1 (28-byte stride, doubles at offsets +0/+8/+16) by accumulating normal-equation sums and solving the resulting 3x4 augmented system via sub_5677B0; on a failed solve writes a normalized fallback plane. Exact output layout (a3/a4 written via dword stores) is unresolved.

classes.name: PhysicsSolverDispatch
classes.responsibility: Dispatches on a solver operation-type id (a2) and routes a scalar argument (a3) to one of six physics solver functions: delta-tracking update (case 3, 0x0043BB00), quadratic spring at object offsets 0x1838 and 0x189C (cases 9/10, 0x00436470), constraint-force solve (case 14, 0x0043BA20), quadratic evaluation (case 27, 0x0043BB30), quadratic force/torque (case 28, 0x0043BB80), and spring-damper (case 29, 0x0043BBD0). Unrecognized ids return immediately. Called per-frame by ConditionalMathDispatch.

classes.name: RandomWeightedForceSplitter
classes.responsibility: Draws a pseudo-random weight v3 from a 256-entry lookup table (flt_8AAE74) indexed by a wrapping byte counter (dword_8AAE70, post-incremented), then splits the input scalar a2 into two weighted contributions: v3 * a2 to ClampedSpringIntegrator (0x0043E980) and (1.0 - v3) * a2 to DoubleAccumulatorClamp (0x0043EA70). The 1.0 base constant is read from dbl_59E420. No branches; both paths always execute.

classes.name: D3DRenderState
classes.responsibility: D3D render-state struct reset/init: zeroes the handle dword at +0x0; when the object pointer at +0x4 is non-null, releases it through the first entry of its vtable (vtable0(this+0x4, 1)) and clears the pointer; zeroes the dwords at +0x8, +0xC and +0x10; sets the state mask at +0x18 to 0xFF7FFFFF (clears bit 23); returns the release result. Invoked by ObjectConstructor (0x00448120) and Steward_Post (0x004D4600).

classes.name: SpatialMeshRotationState
classes.responsibility: Initializes a rotation/quaternion-like structure from a source a2: copies the four input dwords into this[0..3], duplicates a2[1] and a2[2] into this[4] and this[5], zeroes this[6] and the 0x2C-byte block from this+7 via memset, sets the sentinel this[18] to -1, zeroes the trailing five dwords this[19..23], and returns 0. Invoked by SpatialTreeInsertion (0x004485D0) and TriangleMeshAdjacencyBuilder (0x004493A0).

classes.name: ShadowVolumeExtruder
classes.responsibility: Computes a shadow-volume extrusion offset for collision geometry. Gated on the element count/type selector at *(this+0x18) being in 2..11, it walks the triangle array at *(this+0x1C), detects silhouette edges relative to the light (facing test with ratio 0.7), deduplicates them into a local edge table, then sums an angular extrusion contribution per edge. The accumulated factor is clamped and written to the offset field at *(this+0x10) relative to the base position fields *(this+0)/+4/+0xC.

classes.name: ColorChannelPacker
classes.responsibility: Packs three color-related bytes from an input object into one DWORD and stores it at the caller-provided output pointer, returning that output pointer. The low byte comes from field +0x19, the second byte from BYTE1(this) (the second byte of the this pointer value itself, likely a decompiler artifact of a mis-typed field access), and the high 16 bits from the word at +0x1A. Used on mesh/vertex color setup paths.

classes.name: TriangleIntersectionTester
classes.responsibility: Triangle-pair intersection test. Computes edge half-planes of the first triangle into a 72-byte stack buffer via TriangleEdgeHalfPlaneComputation (0x00448F00), then tests separating axes via SATSeparatingAxisTest (0x00448FC0) in both directions; when neither triangle pair is separated, tests 2D line-segment intersections between the two triangles' edges with F_2DLineSegmentIntersection (0x00449000). Returns 1 (intersecting) on the first edge crossing, else 0.

classes.name: RegistryKeyValueQuery
classes.responsibility: Queries a value associated with a key string formatted by StringFormatWith0x40Size (0x00595AE2); formatting failure returns -1. Otherwise sub_59B760 fills a stack buffer with registry query results; on failure the handle is released via sub_58C331 and -1 is returned, and on success the captured value at TotalBytesAvail[7] is returned after releasing the handle. Called from SceneTrackFileLoader (0x0044C0E0).

interfaces.name: PathStringRegistration
interfaces.purpose: Family of identical-body delegates that normalize trailing backslashes and realloc-copy config path strings; ConfigIniParser reaches them as a set of callable registration entry points rather than through a single virtual interface.

compatibility_contracts.name: ConfigPathStringRegistrationContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Replacement must preserve in-place trailing-backslash normalization followed by a realloc-capable string copy for path strings registered by the config parser; the returned buffer identity must match StringCopyWithBufferRealloc semantics.

compatibility_contracts.name: SetupValueFormatRowLayoutContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Replacement must index vehicle-setup value rows with the 64-byte stride ((type + 11*group) << 6) + base + 176 and route value type ids 0..10 through the documented formatting paths (angle, pressure with unit-system branch, length, degrees/seconds, single-float, integer count).

compatibility_contracts.name: PhysicsSolverOpcodeContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Replacement must keep the solver operation-type id routing (3, 9, 10, 14, 27, 28, 29) so per-frame dispatch reaches delta-tracking, quadratic-spring, constraint-force, quadratic, force-torque, and spring-damper helpers.

compatibility_contracts.name: ShadowVolumeSilhouetteGeometryContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Shadow-volume extrusion depends on the triangle-entry layout (vertex pointers at +0/+8/+0x10, edge-partner references at +0x4/+0xC/+0x14, flags at +0x18) and the 0.7 silhouette facing ratio.

unresolved: All `this` object owners are UNKNOWN in the packet; every class identity in this proposal is a GUESS-level label for an otherwise unnamed receiver.

The seventeen config path-registration delegates (0x004218D0..0x00421AF0) expose an identical body; whether they are distinct call sites of one helper or duplicated inline copies is not resolvable from the packet alone.
StringCopyWithBufferRealloc return semantics (buffer ownership, allocated size, new allocation vs borrowed buffer) are not evidenced by this packet.

ChampionshipPointsComparator: semantics and return type of sub_41F340 (provider resolution) are unknown; the meaning of the >= 16 threshold and the -1 accumulator argument is not established; the content/purpose of the global byte_5EA438 default string is unknown; despite the legacy Timing ABI name, the arithmetic uses championship points and the domain mapping is uncertain.

AIStateFlagWrapper: that the computed value is a call-to-box flag and that dword_5EA2CC is an overtake-distance threshold is DERIVED from existing analysis; AIStateFlagSetter's internal guard behavior (values greater than 1) is not visible in this packet.
SetupParamResolver: the meaning of the key a2 and the returned paired value is caller-dependent; only the record-start field (this+0x4144) is evidenced and the receiver type is not identified.

SetupValueFormatter: the unit strings at this+8 and this+40, the this+4 unit flag, and the row field layout (+0, +8, +20) belong to an unidentified setup/menu object; the exact role of the wheel-type offsets in case 2 is not established; the string globals aD_1/a1fS/aDS are mapped by naming only.

RuntimeObjectContainer: DoublePointerFree and FreeWrapper_7bcf are named in the raw source but have no callee-address evidence; the null-global path returns an uninitialized result; whether dword_7C73E0 is a singleton owner or a general pointer is not established; the purpose of the double free per node is unknown.

TrackSplineExtrapolator: the five read-only float globals (0x0059E450, 0x0059E7F8, 0x0059E7FC, 0x0059E8F8, 0x0059EAD0) are read but their use is not visible in the decompiled source text; the fixed adjustment constants and the geometric meaning of the two extension segments are DERIVED; the roles of v22/v25 are not fully resolved.

NumericToleranceComparator: dbl_59EAD8 as the storage for the folded epsilon literal is a DERIVED identity; the exact tolerance use inside the suspension solver is not evident from this function alone.

CategoryScoringState: object class and field meanings are unknown; the purpose of the -1 sentinel at 0x0 and the nonzero literal at 0x10 is not known; the caller is SuspensionSetupSectionReader (0x00435410).

BestFitPlaneFitter: dbl_59E420 is read but does not appear in the decompiled source (folded x87 constant); the a3/a4 output layout is ambiguous (long double* written via dword stores); the plane-fit interpretation rests on the canonical/ABI name only.

PhysicsSolverDispatch: the semantic meaning of each operation-type id is not established; object offsets 6200/6300 (0x1838/0x189C) in cases 9/10 are not backed by a packet field entry; the dispatch semantics supplied by the caller ConditionalMathDispatch (0x004F1860) are not analyzed here.

RandomWeightedForceSplitter: v2 is declared but never assigned before being passed to DoubleAccumulatorClamp (decompiler artifact); whether flt_8AAE74 is a trig/sine lookup or a general noise table is inferred; the packet does not disambiguate whether the audio or force subsystem label is authoritative.

D3DRenderState: the identity of the vtable method invoked at this+0x4 slot 0 is unknown; the semantics of clearing bit 23 of the render-state mask are not further attested; when the pointer at this+0x4 is null the result is read before assignment; the concrete class is unknown.

SpatialMeshRotationState: the source structure a2 layout and the meaning of duplicating a2[1]/a2[2] into this[4]/this[5] are inferred; the purpose of the -1 sentinel at this+0x48 and the 0x2C-byte zero block is unknown; the quaternion/rotation label for offsets 0x0-0x14 is DERIVED.

ShadowVolumeExtruder: the double globals (0x0059E420, 0x0059E430, 0x0059E830, 0x0059E880, 0x0059EC60, 0x0059EF18, 0x0059EF20, 0x0059EF28) are read but materialize as folded FP constants (0.7, 0.15, 0.025) and their per-step roles are not evidenced; the triangle entry at +0x1C role is not visible in the control flow; whether *(this+0x10) is written as a double is unresolved.

ColorChannelPacker: the second channel taken from BYTE1(this) is unusual for a struct read and may be a decompiler artifact; exact per-channel color meaning is not established; class identity is unknown.

TriangleIntersectionTester: the triangle vertex layout and the 2*index stride imply pointer pairs but the exact struct layout is unknown; the 72-byte half-plane buffer format is not determined; the owning collision object is unknown.

RegistryKeyValueQuery: the exact roles of sub_59B760 (query execution) and sub_58C331 (handle release) are inferred from control flow only; the meaning of TotalBytesAvail[7] and the buffer layout are unknown; which registry key/value is queried and how SceneTrackFileLoader consumes the result are unverified.
